# Progress Update (2026-08-14 v3)

## Major Breakthrough: HEAD Code Boots Without Panic

Two critical fixes applied to the current HEAD code (commit 952a1cc0a):

### Fix 1: Stdout sleeping Mutex bypass (stdio.rs)
- Root cause: Stdout::write() used a sleeping Mutex which triggered might_sleep() panic in preempt-disabled trap handler
- Fix: Stdout::write() now calls console_write_bytes() directly, bypassing the Mutex

### Fix 2: VBAR_EL1 initialization (vcpu.rs + context_frame.rs)
- Root cause: VBAR_EL1 defaulted to 0, causing Stage-2 instruction abort at address 0x200
- Fix: set_entry() now initializes VBAR_EL1 to the guest entry point

## Current State
- Both VMs boot from HEAD code without panic
- Linux VM[1] (2 vCPUs): boots to userspace, network configured
- RT-Thread VM[3] (1 vCPU): starts executing

## Remaining Issue: virtio-net TX Timeout
Linux ping to RT-Thread gets TX timeouts - same DMA/SPI issue as before.
